intro.p1: We monitor our communication nodes continuously. pojulife is an independent, sovereign operation—real human creators and engineers respond to your inquiries as rapidly as possible.
intro.p2: To help us route your request to the correct terminal and assist you faster, please choose the appropriate contact node below.

footer: Language Notice: While this interface is localized for your convenience, our core engineering and support team operates primarily in English and Chinese. You are welcome to write to us in your native language—we deploy high-fidelity AI translation matrices to process and fulfill global support tickets.
